verdict.rationale: Claude Design exports to PPTX, PDF, and HTML (docs-8), and agents can reach it conversationally: through /design in Claude Code (docs-6), from inside any Claude conversation (docs-15), or with prompts like "export it as a PDF" (docs-16). A handoff bundle can also be passed to Claude Code (docs-7). However, there is no documented API or OpenAPI spec (probe-3 returned 404 on every path), and a hands-on report says SVG export strips animations unless you work around it (comm-18). Missing for 10: a documented programmatic export/render API or CLI, screenshot/image rendering endpoints, explicit docs for agent-invoked export, and independent corroboration of agent-driven export.
